description: One released lesson in full: the rule, the code pattern, its sources (repository, commit, date), the test files its commits changed, related lessons, and how it was checked (checked: date, verdict, against_commit, and problem when the verdict is not right), and the section of the official documentation on the same subject when one was found (official: relation "agrees" with the section's own sentence as quote, or "topic only" when the section is the reference for the subject without the lesson's point; repo, path, line, url).
